name: Target
copy: Gun covers, knife covers, holsters, cartridge belts and ammunition bags - in traditional and modern designs.
quote: High-quality leather, cut, stitched and finished as hunting accessories - made under one roof.
description: Target is a collection of traditional and modern hunting accessories, including gun covers, holsters, cartridge belts, and ammunition bags, crafted using a combination of high-quality leather and other durable materials.
The range blends classic leatherworking with modern functionality for the active hunter.
